intent: Individually teach suggest doing, support verb/noun, comfortable/comfortably, necessary spelling/infinitive, instead/of doing, already versus all ready, yet questions/negatives and although without doubled but. Rain-plan art supports visible indoor/outdoor contrast with exact story/regions in code. Own production and fresh transfer remain guided; delayed meanings stay protected.
picturePurpose: Original rainy empty courtyard and dry indoor paper activity support the explicitly narrated replacement plan; generation supplies no exact English, activity history or grammar. Evidence regions will locate the chosen setting.

workshop.title: 分清建议、替代和事情进展
workshop.instruction: 每个词先做一个情境或词形判断，再填回句子，最后写自己的例句。看图时分清原计划和实际活动，别把替代关系读反。

items.label: suggest：建议后面接哪种词形
items.prompt: 想建议现在休息一会儿，哪句用法正确？

wordDecision.prompt: 想建议现在休息一会儿，哪句用法正确？

items.material: I suggest taking a short break now.
items.reason: suggest doing表示建议做某事；不要把decide to do或advise somebody to do的结构搬过来。原句中的taking是take的-ing形式，先看前面的动词搭配，再选词形。
items.hint: suggest 后可接 doing，不用 suggest to do。

options.text: I suggest taking a short break now.
options.reason: suggest后可接doing；taking a short break说明建议做的事。

options.text: I suggest to take a short break now.
options.reason: 这里用suggest taking，不能照搬decide to take的搭配。

options.text: I suggest us to take a short break now.
options.reason: 不能照搬advise us to take；可说I suggest taking a short break，或用that从句表达建议。

items.label: support：支持这个动作，也能表示支持
items.prompt: 哪组分别把support用作动词和名词？

wordDecision.prompt: 哪组分别把support用作动词和名词？

items.material: My parents support my plan to join the club.
items.after: my plan to join the club.
items.reason: support可以作动词“支持”，也可作不可数名词。My parents support my plan里它作谓语；with their support或Thanks for your support里它作名词。支持计划不等于计划已经成功。
items.hint: support 可以作动词，也可以作不可数名词。

options.text: They support my plan. / Thanks for your support.
options.reason: 第一句support是动词；第二句your后面的support是不可数名词。

options.text: support只能作名词，不能放在parents后作谓语。
options.reason: support也能作动词；My parents support my plan是正确的主谓宾表达。

options.text: support my plan表示这个计划已经成功。
options.reason: support是支持；是否已经成功，需要另外的行动或结果信息。

items.label: comfortable：描述鞋子，还是修饰走路
items.prompt: 哪组能分别表达“舒适的鞋子”和“走得舒服”？

wordDecision.prompt: 哪组能分别表达“舒适的鞋子”和“走得舒服”？

items.material: These shoes are comfortable for a long walk.
items.reason: comfortable是形容词，可放在are后描述鞋子，也可说comfortable shoes。修饰walk这个动作，用副词comfortably。拼写时comfortable保留comfort，再加-able；副词把末尾-le变成-ly。
items.hint: 注意 comfortable 中保留 comfort 的完整拼写。

options.text: comfortable shoes / walk comfortably
options.reason: comfortable是形容词，修饰shoes；comfortably是副词，修饰walk。

options.text: comfortably shoes / walk comfortable
options.reason: 把形容词和副词换反了；应是comfortable shoes和walk comfortably。

options.text: comfort就是comfortable的副词形式。
options.reason: comfort常作名词或动词；comfortable对应的副词是comfortably。

items.label: necessary：一个c、两个s，后面别漏to
items.prompt: 哪项同时写对necessary，并用对后面的结构？

wordDecision.prompt: 哪项同时写对necessary，并用对后面的结构？

items.material: It is necessary to wash your hands before lunch.
items.after: to wash your hands before lunch.
items.reason: necessary的拼写是n-e-c-e-s-s-a-r-y：一个c、两个s。It is necessary to do表示做某事有必要；不要只顾拼写，又漏掉后面的to。
items.hint: necessary 中一个 c、两个 s，容易混写。

options.text: It is necessary to wash your hands.
options.reason: necessary有一个c、两个s；It is necessary to do表示做某事有必要。

options.text: It is neccessary to wash your hands.
options.reason: neccessary多写了一个c；正确拼写是necessary。

options.text: It is necesary wash your hands.
options.reason: necesary少了一个s，wash前也漏了to；应是necessary to wash。

items.label: instead：换了哪项活动，of后接什么
items.prompt: 这次原计划在操场玩，因下雨改在室内折纸。哪句既说清替代关系，又用对词形？

wordDecision.prompt: 这次原计划在操场玩，因下雨改在室内折纸。哪句既说清替代关系，又用对词形？

art.alt: 原创雨天活动对照：左图是下雨的空篮球场，可见湿地面和水洼；右图两位学生在干燥的室内桌旁折蓝色和紫色纸，桌上有纸船，窗外仍在下雨。

evidence.caption: 右图是室内折纸活动，对照这次改到哪里玩。
室内场景对上了；of后的play该用什么词形，还要回到句子检查。
左图是原计划使用的户外场地；这次实际活动要看右图。

items.material: It was raining, so we played indoors instead.
items.before: It was raining, so we played indoors
items.reason: instead可放句末：We played indoors instead。说清替代什么，用instead of加名词或动名词，如instead of playing outside。先分清实际做的事与被替代的事，再核对of后的词形。
items.hint: instead 可放句末；instead of 后接名词或动名词。

options.text: We played indoors instead of playing outside.
options.reason: 室内活动替代了户外活动；instead of后用playing。

options.text: We played indoors instead of play outside.
options.reason: 地点关系对了，但of是介词，这里后面用playing，不能直接用play。

options.text: We played outside instead of playing indoors.
options.reason: 把实际活动和被替代的活动反过来了；这次改在室内，没去操场玩。

items.label: already：已经，不是all ready
items.prompt: 哪句保留“雨衣已经装好”的意思，且拼写正确？

wordDecision.prompt: 哪句保留“雨衣已经装好”的意思，且拼写正确？

items.material: I have already packed my raincoat.
items.reason: already常用于肯定句，这里放在have与packed之间，表示已经装好。all ready是两个词，表示全都准备好了，如We are all ready。别把一个副词拆成另一个短语。
items.hint: already 常用于肯定句，表示事情已发生。

options.text: I have already packed my raincoat.
options.reason: have already packed说明装雨衣这件事已经完成；already是一个词。

options.text: I have all ready packed my raincoat.
options.reason: all ready表示全都准备好了，不能在这里替换副词already。

options.text: already说明还没有装好雨衣。
options.reason: already在这句肯定句中表示已经；尚未完成常用not...yet。

items.label: yet：是在询问，还是已经给出结果
items.prompt: Have you finished your drawing yet? 这句话最准确的意思是什么？

wordDecision.prompt: Have you finished your drawing yet? 这句话最准确的意思是什么？

items.material: Have you finished your drawing yet?
items.reason: yet常见于疑问句和否定句，通常放句末。Have you finished yet?问是否已经完成；I have not finished yet.表示还没完成。先看句子是询问、否定还是肯定，再判断意思。
items.hint: yet 常见于疑问句和否定句，通常放句末。

options.text: 询问到现在是否完成画作，还需要对方回答。
options.reason: yet在疑问句中表示到现在是否已经；问题本身没有给出完成与否的答案。

options.text: 直接宣布画作已经完成，不需要回答。
options.reason: 问句是在询问，不是完成记录；不能把yet当成肯定的already来读。

options.text: 这句话说明对方连画都还没开始。
options.reason: 问句没有说开始与否，也没有给出进度，不能补出没开始这个事实。

items.label: although：虽然与转折，不重复加but
items.prompt: 要保留“虽然冷，但散步仍很开心”的意思，哪句用法恰当？

wordDecision.prompt: 要保留“虽然冷，但散步仍很开心”的意思，哪句用法恰当？

items.material: Although it was cold, we enjoyed the walk.
items.after: it was cold, we enjoyed the walk.
items.reason: although引导让步从句，表达虽然有这个情况，主句的事情仍然成立。在这里用Although...,...，主句不再加but；也可去掉although，只用but连接。句首Although的A要大写。
items.hint: although 引导让步从句，通常不再与 but 连用。

options.text: Although it was cold, we enjoyed the walk.
options.reason: although引出让步，后面直接接主句；不再加but。

options.text: Although it was cold, but we enjoyed the walk.
options.reason: 这里让步从句已有although，主句不再用but重复连接。

options.text: Because it was cold, we enjoyed the walk.
options.reason: because把天气冷说成开心散步的原因；原句表达的是虽然冷仍然开心。

transfer.passage:
FRIDAY WORKSHOP UPDATE
Jia suggests making paper boats indoors because it is raining. The group accepts her suggestion and folds boats instead of playing outside. Her parents support the plan. Jia has already packed her raincoat, but she has not finished a poster yet. Although the room is small, everyone has enough space to work.

options.text: Although the room is small, everyone has enough space; Jia's poster is not finished yet.
Although the room is small, but everyone has enough space; Jia's poster is not finished yet.
The group plays outside instead of folding paper; Jia's poster is not finished yet.
The group works indoors; Jia has already finished her poster.

answer.display: Although the room is small, everyone has enough space; Jia's poster is not finished yet.

explanation.strategy: 先核对实际活动和完成进度，再检查although的连接方式。

steps.text: 大家改在室内折纸，没有在户外玩；雨衣已装好，海报还没完成。
steps.reason: instead of playing outside说清被替代的事；already packed与not finished yet对应不同任务。

steps.text: although从句说房间小，主句说仍有足够空间，不再加but。
steps.reason: 同一个让步关系不重复用although和but；如果保留but，应去掉although并调整句首。

distractors.reason: 事实基本相符，但在although从句后又加but，重复连接让步关系。
把室内折纸改成户外玩，读反了instead of前后的实际与替代关系。
already packed说的是雨衣；海报明确not finished yet，不能挪用完成状态。

explanation.pitfall: 已经和还没要对应同一件事；instead of别读反；although后别重复加but。

visual.caption: 先对准发生了什么，再检查词形和连接。
